resources.string: Our school first opened its doors in Durban during 2023. Sarah Smith started this whole project because she wanted to make sure that everyone who loves pets has a place to learn how to take care of them the right way. Since we began, we have helped so many different people finish our long 12-week professional courses and our quick 6-week skills classes. It has been great seeing our students learn so much about animals.

We believe that every pet owner should know the basics, like what to feed them or what to do if there is an emergency. Sarah created this academy to teach those hands-on skills that actually help pets live better lives. This education also gives our students the chance to find new jobs in the pet world or even try to start up their own small businesses. We just want to make life better for pets and their owners.
Pick a course from the list to see what it is about.
